divergences.detail: Taxonomy instructional block is not byte-identical. codes added in v2: ['NHB']; codes removed in v2: none.
divergences.justification: The Level-1, Level-2, and feasibility tables are byte-identical between v1 and v2 (confirmed by reading both rendered prompts). The ONLY taxonomy-block difference is v2's appended "### Special code - NHB" subsection. This is the same NHB addition acknowledged under codes_added:NHB, surfaced here by the byte-level taxonomy-identity check. No other instructional text changed.
divergences.directional_bias: See codes_added:NHB (toward F3 at margin). PROVISIONAL.

divergences.detail: v2 makes code 'CC' available that v1 did not.
divergences.justification: Facet of schema_fields_added:classification. Bare CC offered as a Level-1 choice in v2; v1 had only CC.1-CC.4 subtypes. See schema_fields_added:classification.
divergences.directional_bias: See schema_fields_added:classification (toward CC). PROVISIONAL.

divergences.directional_bias: See schema_fields_added:classification (toward CC). PROVISIONAL.

divergences.detail: v2 makes code 'NHB' available that v1 did not.
divergences.justification: v2's barrier prompt adds an explicit NHB (No Harmonization Barrier) code with the rule "NHB pairs are always F1". v1's barrier prompt (create_barrier_prompt in src/pipelines/01_barrier_pipeline.py) presumes a barrier exists ("identify WHY they cannot be directly consolidated") and offers only F1/F2/F3. The NHB code is genuinely new surface area in v2.
divergences.directional_bias: PROVISIONAL. Adding a dedicated no-barrier sink at the bottom of the feasibility range drains the "weak barrier but still harmonizable" cases out of F1/F2, leaving F1/F2 sparser and pushing genuinely hard pairs toward F3. Expected to inflate F3 share relative to v1 and to depress a v1-vs-v2 feasibility kappa simply because v1 used a 3-bucket scale and v2 a 4-bucket scale. Direction: toward F3 at the margin.

divergences.directional_bias: See schema_fields_added:classification (toward CC). PROVISIONAL.

divergences.detail: v2 makes code 'TC' available that v1 did not.
divergences.justification: Facet of schema_fields_added:classification. v2's new bare Level-1 classification field offers TC as a choice; v1 had no bare-L1 field, only the TC.1/TC.2/TC.3 subtypes. See schema_fields_added:classification.
divergences.directional_bias: See schema_fields_added:classification (toward CC). PROVISIONAL.

divergences.detail: v2 output schema adds field 'classification' that v1 lacked.
divergences.justification: v2 adds a standalone Level-1 `classification` field (bare TC|CC|...|NHB) to the output schema, on top of `primary_barrier` (the L1.L2 code). v1's schema had only `primary_barrier`; there was no separate top-level bucket field. Deliberate schema change in v2 to record L1 explicitly.
divergences.directional_bias: PROVISIONAL. Forcing a top-level bucket commitment before the subtype may anchor the model on the broadest defensible L1 (CC, whose definition "concept definition or operationalization differences" absorbs most cases) before it reasons to a specific subtype. Hypothesized to favor CC. Direction: toward CC. This is a hypothesis about ordering effects, not a measured fact.

divergences.detail: v2 output schema adds field 'confidence' that v1 lacked.
divergences.justification: v2 adds a `confidence` output field (0.0-1.0 calibrated confidence in the classification). v1 had no confidence field. Deliberate v2 addition that feeds the confidence-gated gold set in the downstream signal-stratified reproducibility analysis (stage3_v1_v2_signal_stratified.py).
divergences.directional_bias: PROVISIONAL. Metadata about the rating, not an input to choosing the code. Used downstream to gate a high-confidence gold set, not to select the barrier. Direction: none expected on the barrier-label distribution.

divergences.detail: v2 output schema adds field 'consolidation_potential' that v1 lacked.
divergences.justification: v2 adds a `consolidation_potential` output field (yes | no | partial: could QUESTION A be dropped if surveys were person-linked?). v1 passed a consolidation_potential value IN as context but did not ask the rater to EMIT one. Deliberate v2 addition capturing the redundancy/enrichment signal.
divergences.directional_bias: PROVISIONAL. Orthogonal to the barrier label; captures a downstream enrichment signal rather than the harmonization barrier. Direction: none expected on the barrier code.

divergences.detail: v2 output schema adds field 'reference_period_a' that v1 lacked.
divergences.justification: v2 adds a `reference_period_a` output field asking the rater to surface the temporal reference of QUESTION A (or "not specified"). v1 had no such field. Deliberate v2 elicitation aid that makes temporal reasoning explicit.
divergences.directional_bias: PROVISIONAL. Foregrounding reference periods could prime TC (temporal) classifications relative to v1, which never asked for them. NOTE: this points toward TC, the OPPOSITE direction from the CC-attractor the other divergences predict. Flag for Brock: net effect is unmeasured and could partially offset the CC pull. Hypothesis only.

divergences.detail: v2 output schema adds field 'reference_period_b' that v1 lacked.
divergences.justification: v2 adds a `reference_period_b` output field asking the rater to surface the temporal reference of QUESTION B (or "not specified"). v1 had no such field. Same deliberate elicitation aid as reference_period_a.
divergences.directional_bias: PROVISIONAL. See reference_period_a: possibly toward TC at the margin, the opposite direction from the CC-attractor. Unmeasured. Flag for Brock.

divergences.detail: v2 output schema drops field 'additional_barriers' that v1 had.
divergences.justification: v1's schema included an `additional_barriers` list field, letting a rater log secondary barriers (e.g. primary TC.1 with additional CC.2). v2 dropped it: the prompt demands "the SINGLE primary harmonization barrier" and returns one code with no secondary outlet.
divergences.directional_bias: PROVISIONAL. With no outlet for a secondary barrier, a pair that has both (say) a temporal and a construct difference must collapse to one code in v2, whereas v1 could record TC.1 primary + CC.2 additional. When forced to pick one, the broader category (CC) is the safer choice, so the collapse is hypothesized to move mass toward CC. Direction: toward CC.

divergences.detail: v2 output schema drops field 'specific_conflict' that v1 had.
divergences.justification: v1's schema included a `specific_conflict` free-text field (brief description of the exact difference). v2 dropped it; v2's `reasoning` field (2-3 sentences) subsumes that content. No separate specific-conflict outlet in v2.
divergences.directional_bias: PROVISIONAL. Free-text descriptive field, not a coded outlet. Its removal is not expected to move the barrier-label distribution (unlike the dropped additional_barriers field, which WAS a coded secondary outlet). Direction: none expected.

divergences.detail: Framing probe 'additional_barriers_outlet' differs: v1=True, v2=False.
divergences.justification: Facet of schema_fields_removed:additional_barriers, surfaced also as a framing probe. Same dropped field. See that entry.
divergences.directional_bias: See schema_fields_removed:additional_barriers (toward CC). PROVISIONAL.

divergences.detail: Framing probe 'batched_multi_pair' differs: v1=True, v2=False.
divergences.justification: Facet of the one-pair-per-task architecture: v1 batched multiple pairs in a single prompt, v2 sends one. Deliberate, enables per-pair checkpointing. See framing:single_barrier_mandate.
divergences.directional_bias: See framing:single_barrier_mandate (isolation favors general bucket). PROVISIONAL.

divergences.detail: Framing probe 'main_constraint_phrasing' differs: v1=True, v2=False.
divergences.justification: Facet of the single-barrier-mandate change: v1 said "main constraint", v2 says "SINGLE primary barrier". Same design decision, recorded for completeness. See framing:single_barrier_mandate.
divergences.directional_bias: See framing:single_barrier_mandate (toward CC). PROVISIONAL.

divergences.detail: Framing probe 'nhb_offered' differs: v1=False, v2=True.
divergences.justification: Facet of codes_added:NHB surfaced as a framing probe. Same added code.
divergences.directional_bias: See codes_added:NHB (toward F3 at margin). PROVISIONAL.

divergences.detail: Framing probe 'single_barrier_mandate' differs: v1=False, v2=True.
divergences.justification: v1 frames the ask as "the main constraint preventing consolidation" and codes a BATCH of pairs in one prompt (JSON array, "one object per pair"). v2 frames it as "the SINGLE primary harmonization barrier" and codes ONE pair per call. The one-pair-per-task structure is the intended v2 architecture change (enables per-pair checkpoint/retry in the harness).
divergences.directional_bias: PROVISIONAL. Two effects, same direction. (a) "SINGLE" wording plus the dropped additional_barriers field removes the secondary outlet (see above). (b) Coding one pair in isolation removes the cross-pair contrast a batch provides; with no neighbors to differentiate against, the model is hypothesized to reach for the most general explanation (CC). Believed to be the largest single contributor to the v2 CC-attractor. Direction: toward CC. Magnitude unmeasured.

divergences.detail: Framing probe 'single_pair_object' differs: v1=False, v2=True.
divergences.justification: Facet of the one-pair-per-task architecture (v2 returns a single JSON object; v1 returned an array). Same decision as batched_multi_pair.
divergences.directional_bias: See framing:single_barrier_mandate. PROVISIONAL.
